claim: Exact physical state matching achieves residual D <= 1e-10 m across paired counterfactual conditions
limitation: Applies in deterministic MuJoCo simulation via qpos/qvel/act snapshot restoration; not directly realizable on physical hardware without state estimation noise.

claim: Confirmatory benchmark evaluated 20,000 policy rollouts across 200 matched physical failure scenarios across 4 factorial cells
limitation: 5 evaluation seeds per scenario represent repeated deterministic evaluations; statistical inference unit is the N=200 paired scenario.

claim: No statistically significant difference in binary recovery success between nominal history replay (B0) and matched state injection (B4) after Holm-Bonferroni correction (p_adj >= 0.2500)
limitation: Failing to reject the null is not proof of equivalence; bounded by study power (MDE ~6-8% discordance at N=200).

claim: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) confirm practical equivalence within Delta = +/- 0.05 (+/- 5%) margin across all cohorts (pooled delta = +0.78%, 95% Score CI [+0.45%, +1.10%], p_TOST < 10^-147)
limitation: Equivalence margin Delta = +/- 5% is a scientifically justified practical corridor; does not rule out infinitesimal differences < 0.5%.

claim: Negative control policy (reactive feedforward MLP) exhibits exactly 0/200 discordant pairs between B0 and B4 (95% CI [0.00%, 1.83%])
limitation: Confirms absence of state-leakage in the simulation injection harness; bounded by Clopper-Pearson 95% upper limit of 1.83%.

claim: Continuous terminal goal distance error shows no statistically significant difference between B0 and B4 across all four policies (Wilcoxon p_adj = 1.0000)
limitation: Evaluated on 3-DoF planar push tasks with terminal dwell; error is dominated by post-contact damping.

claim: Matching-threshold sensitivity analysis confirms that recovery rate differences remain bounded within +/- 5% across strict (0.001 m), moderate (0.005 m), and loose (0.010 m) thresholds (p_TOST < 10^-100)
limitation: Retrospective sensitivity analysis over 4,000 paired rollouts; strictly bounded to MuJoCo simulated geometric tolerance.

claim: Recovery-horizon sensitivity analysis confirms that risk differences remain within the +/- 5% equivalence corridor across short, intermediate, and extended horizons
limitation: Evaluated across H_rem = 73 to 147 steps; extended horizon yields delta = +1.20% [0.61%, 1.79%], strictly within [-5%, +5%].

claim: Observation modality evaluations demonstrate privileged state exact parity (p=1.0000) and current-observation-only equivalence (delta = +0.73%), while sensor noise remains inconclusive due to sample size
limitation: Visual observation audited as unsupported in current policy checkpoints; noisy state 95% CI [-2.85%, +5.23%] crosses the +5% margin.

claim: Recurrent memory unrolling in GRU policies drives immediate first-action divergence (||Δa_0|| ≈ 0.0038 m/step, Cohen's d ≈ 3.99) and transient trajectory drift (peak 2.48 cm)
limitation: Measured in exploratory pilot diagnostics (N=20 to 45); reflects internal sensitivity to memory prefix rather than terminal recovery failure.

claim: Contact dynamics parameters jointly explain only 7.83% of trajectory divergence variance (R^2_adj = 0.0783); trajectory divergence correlates positively with collisions (r=+0.253) and contact impulse (r=+0.081)
limitation: Observational regression from logged rollouts across 4,000 pairs; establishes association only, not causal intervention proof.

claim: Normal contact constraints and Coulomb friction attenuate intermediate kinematic divergence prior to terminal goal basin
limitation: Supported by observed kinetic energy dissipation and velocity decay upon surface contact; mechanism interpretation bounded to rigid-body planar manipulation.

claim: Privileged geometric oracle achieves 100% recovery filter admissibility on all 200 benchmark scenarios
limitation: Privileged controller possesses full analytical simulator state and geometry; serves strictly as an admissibility filter, not learned policy evidence.
